title: Barbell Plate Calculator (lb and kg)
description: Enter a weight and see exactly which plates go on each side of the barbell. Works in lb or kg, with a 45, 35 or 15 lb bar and the plates your gym has.
lead: Type the total weight you want on the bar and the calculator shows the plates to load on each side. The bar is included in the total, so 135 lb on a 45 lb bar is one 45 lb plate per side.

sections.heading: How the math works
body: Subtract the bar from the total, then split what's left in half. That's the weight for each side. Load the heaviest plates first, then fill in with smaller ones.
If your plates can't make the exact number, the calculator shows the closest weight under it. Most gyms don't have plates smaller than 2.5 lb, so totals usually go up in 5 lb steps.

sections.heading: Common barbell weights
body: On a 45 lb bar, or a 20 kg bar if you lift in kg.
after: When people say one plate, two plates or three plates, they mean 45 lb plates per side. That's 135, 225 and 315 lb.

sections.heading: How much does the bar weigh?
body: A standard Olympic barbell weighs 45 lb, or 20 kg. Many gyms also have a 35 lb or 15 kg bar with a thinner grip, and some have a 15 lb or 10 kg technique bar for learning the lifts.
EZ curl bars are usually around 25 lb, and Smith machine bars vary a lot by machine. If you're not sure, ask the front desk or check the label on the end of the bar.

links.label: How much does a Smith machine bar weigh?

faq.q: Does the bar count toward the weight?
faq.a: Yes. When someone says they bench 135, that includes the 45 lb bar. This calculator works the same way, so enter the total.
Two 45 lb plates per side on a 45 lb bar, which is 225 lb in total.

faq.q: Why can't I make the exact weight?
faq.a: Your gym's plates set the smallest step. With 2.5 lb plates as the smallest, the total goes up in 5 lb steps, because a plate goes on each side.
Usually not. Spring clips weigh almost nothing. Competition collars weigh 2.5 kg each, so count them if your gym uses them.
